slide1_text: All your income and spending in one smart ledger. See where your money comes from and where it goes at a glance.
slide2_text: Click Quick Add at the top right to log a transaction in seconds, or upload a receipt via the + at the bottom right — the amount and category fill themselves in.
slide3_text: Switch between your personal ledger and the family one in a single click — same budget, everyone on their own device.
slide4_text: Net balance, category-by-category spending, your monthly flow chart and budget usage — the dashboard reads your month for you.
slide5_text: Download the month's summary as a PDF and export every transaction to Excel. Share it with your accountant, archive it, or dig in on your own.
tour_hero: This is your month at a glance: money in, money out, and what's left in your pocket. Green means you're doing fine; red means you spent more than you earned.
tour_month: Time-travel from here: change the month and year, and the dashboard shows that month's picture.
tour_quick_add: The most important button in the app. Click it to add an expense or income — logging a record takes seconds.
tour_dock: This compass waits at the bottom right of every page: upload a photo of your receipt — we'll fill in the amount and category for you — or log an expense fast.
tour_scope: Switch ledgers here. Personal: records only you can see. If you create a family ledger, you switch to it here; everyone in it sees the same records.
tour_search: Looking for a record? Type here and press Enter. Example: type 'groceries' and only those show up.
tour_bell: Your notifications gather here: upcoming payments, budget alerts, family invites. See a red badge? Take a look.
tour_menu: Every page lives in this menu: transactions, budgets, goals, investments, reports... Click it to open the menu and start exploring.
tour_outro: That's it! The first time you visit each page, we'll show you its quick tips. Safe travels!
tour_nav_transactions: All your money in and out lives on this page: salary, groceries, bills... Whenever you wonder 'where did my money go?', look here.
tour_nav_categories: Categories group your spending: Groceries, Rent, Fun... Use the built-in ones or add your own with its color and icon.
tour_nav_budgets: Set spending limits here. Example: 'Groceries, 5,000 a month.' The bar fills as you spend; we warn you as you near the limit.
tour_nav_recurring: Set up monthly repeats like rent, salary and bills ONCE. When the day comes, the app adds them by itself — even if you forget.
tour_nav_goals: Your savings goals live here. Set one like 'Vacation, 30,000' and watch the bar fill as you add money.
tour_nav_investments: Gold, dollars, stocks, funds... add whatever you own. We'll show today's value and your profit or loss at current rates.
tour_nav_debts: Who you owe and who owes you — all here. Log payments with 'Add payment'; the remaining amount shrinks by itself.
tour_nav_household: Invite your family here: everyone adds from their own device, everyone sees the same picture. One shared budget, one place.
tour_nav_exports: Get your report here at month's end: PDF summary or Excel list. Download it, share it with your accountant, keep it.
tour_tx_filter: Filter the list here: only income, only expenses, or everything.
tour_tx_add: Click to add a new record — both income and expenses go in here.
tour_tx_hover: A little secret: hover over any record in the list. Edit, move and delete buttons appear at the end of the row.
tour_bg_add: Click to set your first budget: pick a category, type a monthly limit. We'll track the rest.
tour_gl_add: Click to create your first goal: give it a name and an amount. Then use 'Add money' to top it up each month.
tour_rec_popular: Got subscriptions like Netflix or Spotify? Click the logo — everything comes pre-filled; just check the amount and click Add.
tour_rec_add: Set up a monthly repeat like rent, salary or bills ONCE here. When the day comes, the app adds it by itself — even if you forget.
tour_debt_add: Click to add a debt or receivable. Log payments with 'Add payment'; the remaining amount shrinks by itself.
tour_inv_add: Gold, dollars, stocks, funds... click to add your first asset. We'll show today's value and your profit or loss at current rates.
tour_hh_invite: Invite your family here: everyone adds from their own device, everyone sees the same picture. One shared budget, one place.
tour_cat_add: Click to add your own category — pick its color and icon. The built-in ones are always at hand too.
tour_exp_pdf: Download the month's summary as a PDF here — share it with your accountant, archive it.
tour_exp_xlsx: Export every transaction as an Excel list here — dig in on your own.
